extraction.Name: Grover Cleveland Scissons
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Yes, signed a mortgage on the land; mortgage has been foreclosed
extraction.NOTES: Father received the patent and looked after the land; allottee has never seen the patent and does not know anything about its delivery; allottee states he has never received any money out of this land since he got the patent, nor ever, as his father used it before the patent was issued; child died; allottee is making no effort to redeem the land; states 'I should like to have this place back if there is any way that may be done'; subscribed and sworn before Jas.
